entities.name: Prison on Łącki Street
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The National Museum-Memorial of Victims of the Occupation Regimes, or the Prison on Łącki Street, is a former detention center in Lviv, Ukraine, that throughout the 20th century was primarily used as a political prison by the Polish, Nazi and Soviet regimes.
